note: BLM campground in the pines of the Muddy Mountain Environmental Education Area south of Casper: WY-251 over Casper Mountain, then County Road 505 (pavement ends after about 3 miles) and about 6.5 miles of gravel. Sites on a gravel loop with level tent pads and fire rings. A 2-mile accessible interpretive trail links it with Rim Campground. Cell reception spotty. --Claude
summary: BLM page + rec.gov 272188 read: 15 sites incl. a few pull-throughs, 2 double vault toilets, potable water, $7 + $3 extra vehicle cash/check, 14-night limit.
